title: Product bound 1 ≤ Π(1+λᵢ) ≤ 1 + 2^m Σλᵢ for λᵢ ∈ [0,1]
statement: For every m ∈ ℕ and every λ : Fin m → ℝ (Lean: lam) with 0 ≤ λ_i ≤ 1 for all i: 1 ≤ Π_i (1 + λ_i) and Π_i (1 + λ_i) ≤ 1 + 2^m Σ_i λ_i. The empty product is 1 and the empty sum is 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (lam : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) → (∀ i, lam i ≤ 1) → 1 ≤ ∏ i, (1 + lam i) ∧ ∏ i, (1 + lam i) ≤ 1 + 2 ^ m * ∑ i, lam i
